title: Peggy's Cove Small-Group Express: Scenic Tour from Halifax
includes: 1 hour of free time to explore Peggy’s Cove at your own pace
Premium Transportation to Peggy's Cove Lighthouse
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Guests with infants must bring their own car seats (required)
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the beautiful Peggy’s Cove, with our fun and friendly local guides who will take you from your downtown Halifax hotel to the iconic Peggy’s Cove. 

Enjoy the most photographed lighthouse in Canada and its beautiful surrounding area on our Peggy’s Cove Express trip, including complimentary hotel pick up and drop off anywhere in Downtown Halifax.

Your guide will greet you at your downtown Halifax accommodations. You will then head towards the picturesque fishing village of Peggy’s Cove, located about an hour from Halifax.

Once your guide drops you off at Peggy's Cove you will have the opportunity to take a picture with the most photographed lighthouse in Canada - the iconic Peggy’s Cove Lighthouse and explore for an hour and a half!

At the end of your trip at Peggy’s Cove, your driver will drop you back off at your Downtown Halifax hotel. 

Trip is 4 hours depending upon traffic and your pick up.
